pack.title: Street transit
pack.description: Respond to a fair request without treating it as an attack.

scenarios.setting: A passenger asks you to move your bag so they can sit and you respond defensively at first.
scenarios.jab: Does your bag need its own seat?
scenarios.goal: Respond to a fair request without treating it as an attack.

replies.why: It accepts a reasonable request and resolves the issue immediately.
replies.delivery: Move the bag as you speak; a practical correction matters more than a clever response.

replies.why: It makes the space available without defending the mistake.
replies.delivery: Move the bag as you speak; a practical correction matters more than a clever response.

replies.line: Sorry about that; let me move it so you can sit.
replies.why: It acknowledges the inconvenience and performs the requested change.
replies.delivery: Move the bag as you speak; a practical correction matters more than a clever response.

replies.line: Its free ride ends here; have a seat.
replies.why: Humor concerns the bag while welcoming the passenger.
replies.delivery: Move the bag as you speak; a practical correction matters more than a clever response.

followUp.why: It closes the exchange politely rather than extending a defensive explanation.
followUp.delivery: Move the bag as you speak; a practical correction matters more than a clever response.
